credit_default.title: Credit Default Risk Model -- Independent Validation \& Fair-Lending Remediation
bullets: Took delivery of a LightGBM credit-default model reporting \textbf{0.9636 AUC}, reproduced it to 15 decimal places, then proved by counterfactual that \textbf{85\% of its performance was leakage} -- five features describing repayment on the loan being scored.

Rebuilt under a \textbf{governance policy enforced in code} -- excluding gender, marital status, and pincode as prohibited bases under \textbf{ECOA/Reg B} -- with the remediated model scoring a defensible \textbf{Gini 0.2914} on a hold-out touched exactly once.
Measured the cost of each governance decision separately: fair-lending compliance was free (Gini changed by +0.0013), while leakage removal accounted for 96\% of the total performance drop.

Shipped as a decision system: \textbf{isotonic calibration}, \textbf{SHAP-based} adverse-action reason codes, a WOE logistic-regression challenger, production \textbf{drift monitoring (PSI)}, backed by 243 automated tests and CI.

aml_fraud.title: AML Fraud Detection Pipeline (DuckDB, Optuna, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker, CI/CD)
bullets: Built an end-to-end \textbf{fraud/anomaly-detection system} (Python, \textbf{DuckDB}, Scikit-learn) on \textbf{6.36 million real} PaySim mobile-money transactions (0.13\% fraud rate), running \textbf{3-fold time-based cross-validation} across 8 models with \textbf{Optuna}-based hyperparameter optimization and \textbf{MLflow} tracking -- best model (LightGBM) reaching \textbf{PR-AUC 0.997}.

Replaced label-derived evaluation with a \textbf{capacity-based operating point} to set a deployable threshold before ground truth exists -- \textbf{250 reviews/day yields 95.1\% recall at zero false positives}.

Diagnosed and fixed a \textbf{production-stability bug} crashing an 8GB machine on full-dataset runs, rewriting the aggregation as a \textbf{DuckDB SQL window function} and cutting peak memory from a multi-GB spike to \textbf{1.4GB}.
Backed the system with a \textbf{182-test automated suite} and shipped a \textbf{FastAPI} scoring service and \textbf{Docker}-containerized image behind a green \textbf{3-job CI/CD} gate.

nectar_iot.title: Nectar IoT Analytics Platform -- Predictive Maintenance \& Prognostics
bullets: Took \textbf{complete ownership} of an end-to-end \textbf{predictive maintenance and prognostics} pipeline (Python, Scikit-learn, \textbf{XGBoost}) on \textbf{1.96 million rows of physics-grounded multivariate sensor telemetry} across 151 interconnected equipment assets (chillers, AHUs, pumps), built on a custom signal generator modeling \textbf{per-asset-type fault archetypes} and \textbf{ISO 10816-consistent vibration bands}.

Identified and validated a forward-looking vibration signal (1.48x baseline) preceding equipment faults as a leading prognostic indicator, correcting two earlier flawed versions of the same measurement found via self-audit.

Built a \textbf{multi-method anomaly-detection module} (statistical thresholds, Isolation Forest, CUSUM change-point detection) alongside \textbf{24-hour-ahead failure prediction} (Precision 0.90, Recall 0.75), plus a graph-based (\textbf{NetworkX}) connectivity analysis.
Designed a \textbf{single, shared, modular data pipeline} reused across the pipeline, dashboard, and API, backed by \textbf{55 automated tests}.

marketing_mix.title: Marketing Mix Model -- Real Retail Data, Honestly Scored
bullets: Audited and rebuilt an inherited MMM pipeline onto \textbf{real weekly retail data} (209 weeks, 10 channels, \$490.9M spend, plus a 26-division geo panel), finding its "multicollinearity" thesis was manufactured by its own synthetic generator -- real \textbf{VIF stays below 4} versus a claimed 8--13.

Reached and defended a \textbf{negative result} -- media spend does not improve out-of-sample prediction -- via \textbf{rolling-origin and nested evaluation} on data untouched by tuning, which strengthened the finding rather than softening it.
Found and fixed \textbf{two arithmetic bugs} in the inherited geo-experiment estimator; derived a \textbf{12.0\% minimum detectable effect} and confirmed unbiased recovery of injected lifts.

\textbf{Forensically verified} the data's authenticity against Federal Reserve series (r=0.9967); shipped as a tested (64 tests), CI-backed package with an optimizer that refuses to output a recommendation when statistically unstable.

medbot.title: MEDBOT -- Knowledge-Grounded Medical RAG Assistant (Gen AI / LLM)
bullets: Designed and built a \textbf{GenAI/RAG application} (Python, \textbf{LangChain}, \textbf{Google Gemini}, local \textbf{fastembed} embeddings, \textbf{FAISS} -- 1,225/1,225 indexed chunks) for knowledge-grounded medical question-answering, migrating off a paid OpenAI dependency onto a fully free-tier stack.

Fixed \textbf{three real bugs} surfaced by end-to-end testing: a PubMed TLS interception issue, a Wikipedia 403 error, and a SerpAPI exception-handling bug where a bad API key silently discarded all three external sources instead of just the failing one.

Applied and evaluated \textbf{Chain-of-Thought prompting} via a structured \textbf{A/B test with an ablation study}, alongside a 27-example \textbf{few-shot prompt template} with semantic-similarity example selection.

Built a genuine \textbf{evaluation harness} -- not qualitative spot-checks -- measuring retrieval \textbf{Precision@4 (0.83)} and generation \textbf{groundedness (0.83)} against a 24-question test set, using it to discover a corpus-coverage gap and a reproducible false-refusal bug invisible to code review.
Shipped behind a \textbf{CI/CD} pipeline with an index-integrity gate, deployed via \textbf{Streamlit} in a containerized (Dev Containers) reproducible environment.

clinical_emr.title: Clinical EMR SQL Pipeline \& Mortality Prediction (MIMIC-III)
bullets: Built a \textbf{SQL-first analytics pipeline} on real, de-identified MIMIC-III ICU patient records (100 patients, 129 admissions), loading a 6-table relational schema into SQLite and querying it directly rather than pre-flattening the data.

Extended the SQL layer with \textbf{window functions} (\textbf{ROW\_NUMBER, LAG}) to sequence each patient's repeat admissions, surfacing that 11 of 29 repeat admissions fall within a 30-day readmission window.

Identified and fixed \textbf{target and patient-level leakage} in an initial model, replacing a single-split evaluation with a tuned \textbf{Random Forest} via patient-grouped 5-fold cross-validation (\textbf{ROC-AUC 0.606}).
Backed the pipeline with a \textbf{19-test automated suite} on GitHub Actions CI, including a regression guard against leaky features reappearing.

tech_vendor.title: Tech Vendor Market Share \& Growth Analysis (Excel)
bullets: Built a \textbf{7-tab Excel competitive-intelligence model} (424 formulas, fact/dimension design) tracking quarterly revenue, growth, and market share for 5 major cloud vendors, using \textbf{INDEX/MATCH, VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNT, and data validation}.

Audited an existing analysis end-to-end, independently recomputing every insight against underlying formulas and identifying/correcting a factual error in a market-share claim before it reached a stakeholder.

Sourced and verified \textbf{40 data points against real primary-source SEC filings and earnings releases}, catching and correcting 2 numeric errors and identifying one vendor whose figures could not be substantiated.

powerco.title: PowerCo Customer Churn \& Pricing Strategy Analysis (BCG X Job Simulation)
bullets: Took \textbf{complete ownership} of a client engagement for an energy-sector client -- design, feature engineering, hypothesis testing, modelling, and evaluation -- to test the hypothesis that pricing was the dominant driver of SME customer churn (\textbf{14,606 customers}).

Built a \textbf{Random Forest} classification model, interpreting findings to overturn the client's original hypothesis -- identifying consumption and net margin, not pricing, as the true dominant drivers.
Delivered a client-facing Executive Summary, presenting a cost-justified, revenue-conscious business-strategy recommendation -- translating model output into quantified business impact.

movie_recommender.title: Movie Recommender System -- Collaborative Filtering with MLOps Scaffolding
bullets: Built a \textbf{collaborative-filtering recommender}, implementing \textbf{matrix factorization from scratch} (NumPy, gradient descent) on real \textbf{MovieLens 100K} data, with leakage-safe per-user chronological splitting and hyperparameters tracked in \textbf{MLflow}.

Built a dual-family \textbf{evaluation harness} (RMSE/MAE vs. constant-predictor, Precision@10/Recall@10 vs. random reference) plus a \textbf{popularity-bias audit} testing whether personalization was genuinely happening.

Self-audit caught an earlier version's "5x better than baseline" claim was measuring pure noise (permutation test z=-2.59); fixed on real data and published an honest tied result vs. the popularity baseline. Shipped via \textbf{FastAPI}, Streamlit, Docker, and CI.

nifty_arima.title: NIFTY 50 ARIMA/GARCH Forecasting \& Model Audit (R + Python)
bullets: Reproduced a published \textbf{ARIMA(6,1,6)} time-series model for the NIFTY 50 index (263 weekly observations, 2017--2022) in \textbf{R and Python}, then self-audited it via coefficient-significance testing and Ljung-Box diagnostics -- finding 92\% of coefficients statistically insignificant.
Designed a \textbf{rolling-origin cross-validation} framework across 87 expanding-window origins to benchmark ARIMA, auto-ARIMA, ETS, and random-walk candidates against a live financial time series.
Extended the analysis to \textbf{volatility forecasting} with a GARCH(1,1) model, confirming genuine, statistically significant \textbf{volatility clustering}.

hidani_tech.title: Hidani Tech -- Data Analyst Technical Assessment
bullets: Built an end-to-end Python analytics pipeline on a real 1,000-row sales/lead dataset -- cleaning inconsistent date formats and resolving \textbf{285 missing Associate/Team-Lead names} -- to answer 9 stakeholder-defined business questions covering \textbf{conversion rates, funnel analysis, and revenue trends}.
Caught a \textbf{payment-status data-quality issue}: the obvious "overdue" definition returned 702 near-meaningless cases; redefined it to cut it to \textbf{21 genuinely actionable cases}.

\textbf{Self-audited} the finished notebook and dashboard, catching 4 additional bugs on re-review, and \textbf{verified the dashboard live} using headless browser automation (Playwright) before delivery.

bike_taxi.title: Bike Taxi Demand Forecasting -- Data Governance, Clustering \& Scaled Pipeline
bullets: Built an end-to-end, scalable Python pipeline processing \textbf{878,400 observations} from ~8.4 million raw multi-source booking records, from raw ingestion through feature engineering to a stakeholder-facing dashboard.

Authored a \textbf{data-governance document} mapping the pipeline's personal-data boundary to \textbf{India's DPDP Act 2023} and enforcing it in code -- real data-privacy standards applied in practice.
Applied unsupervised \textbf{KMeans clustering} for geospatial demand segmentation across 50 regions, then compared Linear Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost via cross-validation.

vaccination_nlp.title: Vaccination Tweet Sentiment Analysis (NLP)
bullets: Audited an inherited \textbf{NLP sentiment-classification} pipeline (11,020 real tweets, \textbf{TF-IDF}, Logistic Regression/LinearSVC via GridSearchCV) that "looked done" at 87\% accuracy, and found it was not actually trustworthy.
Found and fixed a \textbf{negation-handling bug} where standard stopword removal deleted "not/no/nor" before sentiment scoring, silently flipping negated tweets' polarity.

Diagnosed and fixed a \textbf{data-leakage bug} -- the TF-IDF vectorizer had been fit on the full dataset before the train/test split -- improving negative-sentiment recall from 38\% to \textbf{51\%}.

call_center_dl.title: Deep Learning Call Center Forecasting (MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM)
bullets: Built and benchmarked \textbf{4 deep learning architectures} (\textbf{MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM}) in \textbf{TensorFlow/Keras} to forecast monthly healthcare call-center volume from 11 years of historical data, using lagged-window feature engineering and chronological splitting to prevent data leakage.

Evaluated all models on MAE, RMSE, and MAPE, finding that simpler feedforward architectures (MLP, CNN) outperformed recurrent ones at this data scale -- MLP achieved the best RMSE (0.15) -- and diagnosed training-set size as the root cause rather than accepting the counter-intuitive result at face value.
Verified the finding was real, not an artifact, by rerunning the full pipeline from a clean state twice and confirming bit-for-bit identical results both times.
